title: Marked homotopies induce parameterized precomposition on relative flat mapping objects
statement:
Use simplicial sets, standard simplices, degreewise products and internal functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and marked simplicial sets, marking-preserving maps, coordinatewise product markings and $K^\flat,K^\sharp$ of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model]. Fix a small simplicial set $S$ and marked simplicial sets $U,V,W$ with maps to $S$, in a fixed containing universe. Define $\operatorname{Map}^\epsilon_S(P,Q)_k$ to be the marked maps $P\times(\Delta^k)^\epsilon\to Q$ over $S$, with base map ignoring the parameter, for $\epsilon=\flat,\sharp$; operators restrict the parameter.

Let $h_0,h_1:U\to V$ be marked maps over $S$, and let $H:U\times(\Delta^1)^\flat\to V$ be a marked map over $S$ with these endpoints. The formula which sends a $k$-simplex $(a,\tau)$, where $a:V\times(\Delta^k)^\flat\to W$ is marked over $S$ and $\tau:\Delta^k\to\Delta^1$, to
$$U\times\Delta^k\longrightarrow W,\qquad (u,v)\longmapsto a(H(u,\tau(v)),v)$$
defines a simplicial map
$$\Phi_H:\operatorname{Map}^\flat_S(V,W)\times\Delta^1\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}^\flat_S(U,W).$$
Its endpoint maps are the simplicial precomposition maps $h_0^*,h_1^*$. Its component at a vertex $a:V\to W$ is the edge represented by $a\circ H$. If $H$ also preserves the additional markings of $U\times(\Delta^1)^\sharp$, each such component belongs to $\operatorname{Map}^\sharp_S(U,W)_1$. No fibrancy of $U,V,W,S$ is assumed, and the simplices $a$ need not have invertible parameter edges.
